meta.description: MSE-delta curve properties study for MDM method (S4.9.3: geometric trace grid, brent_root / truncated_at_zero / right_edge_fit semantics)

curve_shapes.desc: MSE has a clear interior minimum. Common for moderate n and beta.
MSE increases with delta. Optimal delta near 0. Common for small n.
MSE decreases with delta. Optimal delta at boundary. Requires large search range.
Very narrow valley (width ~0.005). Requires fine step size.

conclusions.failure_condition: S4.9.3 default MDM has three solver outcomes: (1) brent_root with root_solver=brent when g(0)<offset and a right bracket is found; (2) truncated_at_zero when g(0)>=offset and the unconstrained root is clipped by gamma>=0; (3) brent_root with root_solver=right_edge_fit when the fixed trace grid/right anchor is still below offset and the solver returns a near-t_min interior point.
conclusions.failure_condition_historical: Pre-S4.9.3 studies used implementation failure diagnostics. Those are historical diagnostics, not current default MDM failure modes.
conclusions.boundary_samples: Samples where optimal delta is at the search boundary have inherent MDM accuracy limits. These should be flagged in training data but not filtered out.
conclusions.boundary_samples_s49: S4.9.3: 当离散 trace 或当前右端锚点仍低于 offset 时，默认 MDM 不再返回失败诊断；系统标记 root_solver=right_edge_fit，并在 [0, t_min) 内补出 near-t_min 解。truncated_at_zero 仅在 gamma=0 处梯度 >= offset 时触发。
